changelog: Home now shows every YouTube Music shelf title, plus nine personalised sections after New releases.
Library + opens a bottom sheet with Create playlist, Import playlist and Folder.
The track menu now has Remove from this playlist for local and YouTube Music playlists.
The Queue has a clear-upcoming action that keeps the current song playing.
Artwork now loads from Spotify, then Apple iTunes, then YouTube Music.
Folder is listed in the Library sheet and is coming soon.
